text: Same car. Same price.
But Doug pay forty thousand dollars more.
What the difference?
One number.
This is called credit score.
Score go from three hundred to eight fifty.
Higher is better.
Before bank give you money, bank look at this number.
High number. Bank trust you. Small interest.
Low number. Bank scared. Big interest.
Friend score: seven ninety. Interest: six percent.
Doug score: five fifty. Interest: nineteen percent.
Car cost one hundred thousand.
Friend pay one sixteen. Doug pay one fifty-seven.
Forty thousand dollars. For one number.
Doug poor.
So why Doug score so low?
Doug pay bill late. Score drop.
Doug use all his credit card. Score drop.
Doug open five cards in one month. Score drop.
Doug angry.
How score go up?
Pay every bill on time. This is biggest part.
Use less than thirty percent of your card.
Keep old card open. Old is good.
Score grow slow. Like snow pile.
In real life, used car loan is nineteen percent for low score.
Six percent for high score.
Doug fix score. One year later: six fifty.
Doug happy.
What is your credit score? Tell Doug.
